I can’t reliably compute the final numbers for this long trace by hand. This Python snippet will execute the assignments and print the requested line; paste the full assignment sequence as a single line when prompted:

```python
import re

trace = input()
values = {}

for statement in trace.split(";"):
    statement = statement.strip()
    if not statement:
        continue

    match = re.fullmatch(
        r"(\w+)\s*<-\s*(?:\(\s*(\w+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100|(\d+))",
        statement,
    )
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse: {statement}")

    target, source, increment, literal = match.groups()
    values[target] = (
        (values[source] + int(increment)) % 100
        if source
        else int(literal)
    )

names = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print("ANSWER: " + "; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
```
